s1: You can buy a business making one crore rupees a year, for just twenty seven lakh. Let me explain.
s2: Let's say there's a bakery. It makes one crore a year in sales. One day, the owner says he's selling.
s3: You think, okay, one crore business, so I need one crore to buy it. Wrong.
s4: That one crore isn't what he takes home. Staff, ingredients, rent, electricity. After all of it, the bakery keeps fifteen lakh a year in operating profit.
s5: Here's the thing. You're not buying sales. You're buying its ability to make money. Pay three times that profit, and it's forty five lakh.
s6: A one crore bakery for forty five lakh. Sounds like a steal. Well, not so fast.
s7: What if the owner is the head baker? The moment he leaves, you hire someone for six lakh a year.
s8: Now fifteen lakh of profit becomes nine. Same three times, and your forty five lakh drops to twenty seven.
s9: Same bakery. Same one crore in sales. A completely different price.
s10: So the real question isn't how much it sells. It's how much it will make after you take over.
s11: Save this reel. And if you'd rather buy than build, DM LORE.
